author: Sabine, 1819
habitat: 번식기에는 습한 툰드라, 비번식기에는 트인 바다
summary: 우리나라에서는 미조로 기록된 갈매기이다. 번식기에는 습한 툰드라에서 지내고, 번식기가 지나면 대개 트인 바다에서 생활하며 겨울은 열대 지역에서 보낸다. 주로 곤충을 잡아먹고 연체동물과 물고기도 먹는다. 5월 하순~7월 상순에 한배에 알 2~3개를 낳는다.

points.en: grey hood edged by a black collar (breeding)
white forehead, dusky rest of head (non-breeding)
black bill with a yellow tip
black primaries and broad white triangle on the secondaries

art.subject: Sabine's Gull (Xema sabini), adult in breeding plumage: dark slate-grey hood edged below by a narrow black collar, against a white neck and body; mantle and inner wing coverts medium grey; outer primaries and their coverts black with small white tips, forming a black triangle along the outer leading edge of the wing; inner primaries and secondaries white, forming a broad white triangle; tail white and clearly forked. Black bill with a yellow tip; dark eye with a red eye-ring; dark grey legs.
art.pose: flying low over the sea, showing the black-and-white wing pattern
art.scene: open sea off the Korean coast under a wide sky; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing: slate-grey hood with a narrow black collar, black bill with a yellow tip, grey back, long black wingtips with white spots, dark grey legs
adult non-breeding, head detail: white forehead and face, dusky grey half-hood on the nape and hindneck, black bill with a yellow tip

adult in flight, seen from above: grey mantle and coverts, black outer primaries forming a black triangle on the outer wing, broad white triangle on the inner primaries and secondaries, forked white tail
art.build: Small, elegant gull, 33–36cm, smaller than the Black-headed Gull; rounded head and short neck. Bill short and fine, shorter than the head. Legs short, dark grey. At rest the long black wingtips with white spots project well beyond the tail. In flight the long, pointed wings show a bold three-triangle pattern of grey coverts, black outer wedge and white inner triangle, and a forked tail; flight buoyant and tern-like.
avoid: Do not paint a brown hood with white eye crescents, a red bill and red legs; those mark the Black-headed Gull (Chroicocephalus ridibundus).
Do not paint a white leading edge to the outer wing; the outer leading edge is black.
Do not make the tail square; it is forked.
